# Button

Buttons trigger actions.

Use one primary button per screen.

## Variants

Use `intent="danger"` for destructive actions.

```tsx title="Danger"
<Button intent="danger">Delete</Button>
```

## Sizing

```tsx
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>
```

```sh
npm install @acme/ui
```
